policy: Uniform sampling without replacement; use every neighbor when degree <= fanout; no weighted or label-dependent sampling
determinism: NumPy PCG64 seeded by SHA256 of organization, branch, asof, supplied seed, model-layer index and private local node key. Independent of call order, root batch partition and process hash randomization; record NumPy version.
temporal_policy: All hops sample only the same immutable accepted graph view at root scoring t, with edges retained in (t-7 days,t]. This is as-of GraphSAGE sampling, not a temporal GNN or decreasing-time random walk.
block_policy: Expand backwards from User roots in reverse model-layer order; return blocks in model execution order. Each destination set is the prefix of its source set. Only sampled neighbor-to-destination edges enter each block; GraphSAGE root transform supplies self information.
roots: Every active User is a candidate; IP nodes are context only. Masks never affect neighbor choices. Default deterministic local User order; no event-time shuffle.
adjacency: Sorted CSR over accepted bidirectional unique User-IP adjacency; O(N+E) structural memory; tensor batches bounded by fanouts and batch_size
tuning: These are versioned input-pipeline smoke-test defaults, not validation-selected model architecture; any later sampler changes require a new sampler version and TRAIN/VAL-only selection. Frozen split/grid/FPR/evaluation-unit protocol remains unchanged.
